title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for M/Nm in terms of m, B, and τ.

title: Use of Entropy
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the entropy function and its relation to multiplicity.

title: Correct Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly derive the relationship between energy, temperature, and magnetization.

title: Gaussian Integral
description: Important Criteria: The student should show familiarity with Gaussian integrals and their application in the problem.

title: Dimensional Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student may use dimensional analysis to support their final answer or reasoning.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final expression.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms in their final answer are dimensionally consistent.
